question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which nerd do you want to see more of?

nodes.text: Ben twists out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hah!
Spencer stops, turns around, and raises his fist to punch Ben when...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ninja!
Erik jumps on Spencer's back!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whoa, look at that nerd pile!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're two ropes short of a nerd ball!
Dex tugs at Spencer's arm, and Brendan dives for Spencer's feet!
Spencer takes three mighty steps, dragging all three of them across the floor.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Whoa, Spencer's tough! It'll take more than three nerds to bring him down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's why I'm the fourth!
Ben pushes Spencer! With the weight of the three nerds, Spencer topples over. Erik, Dex, and Brendan roll safely out of the way as Spencer falls.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh, I hurt in so many places right now...
He turns his head away from the Auto-Shop and shoots a grin at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That shows you what we nerds are capable of! Now don't bother beating us up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. I give up for now.
Spencer stands and leaves. There is the sound of someone clapping from the Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That was some fight.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But next time, take it away from the Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!
The nerds run away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They looked impressed! I think they'll let us sit at their table tomorrow!
Ben forgets to dodge, and Spencer plows right into him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Ben flies sideways and falls right in front of the Auto-Shop entrance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unnnhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You were supposed to dodge, you moron!
Ben tries to get up, but staggers and falls again.
A laugh resounds through the Auto-Shop as Ben staggers to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ha ha... What do you two think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, fighting?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You call that a fight? I've seen slumber parties more vicious than you two.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: If you're going to fake a fight, at least make it look good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You knew we were faking?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh yeah! I watch professional wrestling. And that's `real` fake fighting!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah! I watch professional wrestling. And that's [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] fake fighting!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Here's a pro tip for next time... Be better.
Spencer helps Ben up. Ben shakes himself off, and they meet up with the other nerds.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ben, what were you thinking? You threw the whole plan off!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I got really confused. When were we supposed to ambush Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: After Ben dodged Spencer's charge... Which `didn't happen.`
nodes.text_bbcode: After Ben dodged Spencer's charge... Which [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't happen.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. It's my fault the plan didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we both knew it was going to look fake if you took me down by yourself, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, getting into a shoving match with you was not my brightest idea.
As they walk away, Ben looks back at the Auto-Shop. Kenji and Megan point and laugh in their general direction.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I can only hope we made an impression... I wonder if they'll still let us sit with them tomorrow.
Ben waits. Behind Spencer, Dex shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, if no one's attacking, it's my turn!
Spencer kicks Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!
Ben stumbles back a bit, and Spencer starts to charge at him!
Ben kicks at Spencer! Spencer jumps over the kick!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why you!
As they planned, Spencer starts to charge at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, if no one's attacking, it's my turn!
Spencer kicks Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!
Ben stumbles back a bit, and Spencer starts to charge at him!
Ben stands there dumbly, waiting for something to happen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, if no one's attacking, it's my turn!
Spencer kicks Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!
Ben stumbles back a bit, and Spencer starts to charge at him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, what now?
Ben waits...
And Dex flies out at Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ahhhh! Nerd attack!
Dex jumps on Spencer, messing up his balance! Spencer topples slightly but regains his footing as Dex rolls safely away.
Ben punches Spencer, and Spencer barely dodges out of the way.
Behind him, Dex hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, `what` are you doing?! I'm going to pummel you for that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Kale, [color=#e23b3b][i]what[/i][/color] are you doing?! I'm going to pummel you for that!

nodes.text: Ben punches Spencer, and Spencer barely dodges out of the way.
Behind him, Dex hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, `what` are you doing?! I'm going to pummel you for that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Kale, [color=#e23b3b][i]what[/i][/color] are you doing?! I'm going to pummel you for that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! I forgot what to do!
Ben punches Spencer, and Spencer barely dodges out of the way.
Behind him, Dex hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, `what` are you doing?! I'm going to pummel you for that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What happens now?
Ben punches at Spencer! He blocks the punch!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhh!` You really kicked my shin!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhhhhh![/i][/color] You really kicked my shin!

nodes.text: Ben kicks Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhh!` You really kicked my shin!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhhhhh![/i][/color] You really kicked my shin!

nodes.text: Ben hesitates!
Spencer shoots him a look, and Ben kicks Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhh!` You really kicked my shin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I'll need everyone's help to make this battle look epic!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Great! I got this. First, we...
Spencer lays out a fake fight for the nerds. A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, that's the plan!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're doing this after school, so everyone has to be ready!
After school that day, they review the plan on the way to the Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, Kale. We're going to have a pretend fight in front of the rebels.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Remember what you have to do. First, you're going to take a fake punch at me, and I'm going to block.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then you `wait` for Dex to attack...
nodes.text_bbcode: Then you [color=#e23b3b][i]wait[/i][/color] for Dex to attack...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And then you kick at me! In that order! You got that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah!
The nerds take their places in front of the Auto-Shop.
Dex runs into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Watch it, dweeb! Out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sp... Spencer! I'm sorry, I...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! No 'sorry's from a dweeb like you! I am going to take you down!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fight, fight!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Heh. This ought to be good.
Ben steps in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, you can't beat up this poor nerd!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can do whatever I want!
Spencer shoves Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do I do first?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ye-eah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ye-eah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I like any idea with the word 'fight' in it!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Why would we do that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are the rebels known for? Going against society, being against the dominant culture, and being tough!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think we're quite committed to going against society since we want to be popular...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we can prove how tough we are!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What if we aren't?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's why we're `staging` a fight, not getting into an actual one.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why we're [color=#e23b3b][i]staging[/i][/color] a fight, not getting into an actual one.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can look cool `and` be safe!
nodes.text_bbcode: We can look cool [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] be safe!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And safety is priority number one!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The rebels are known for being mean, tough, and hard.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Things that we are not.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So we don't fight fire with fire, we just play to our strengths.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof, bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? We're smart and nice...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can capitalize on that by helping the Auto-Shop with their building projects!
At the end of the lunch period, the nerds try to help the rebels in the Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You think you know more about bikes than I do?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I do know the exact composition needed to help you speed up more efficiently.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't need fancy words to tell me how much gas to put in my motorcycle. Get lost.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No! For the last time, I need a socket wrench!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So... Not a scalpel?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't even know what that is!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nerd-brain, if I catch you connecting and disconnecting wires from the tumbler again, I'm going to crush you!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I was just trying to organize the wires more effectively by...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Didn't I just say I'd crush you?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Eep!
The nerds walk out of the Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... Maybe we should go with a different tact.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You doofus, the only thing rebels respond to is strength!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, Spencer... We need to get into a fight!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ye-eah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ye-eah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A real one?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, a fake one. We choreograph a fake fight, so that we all look cool, but no one gets hurt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Tell me what I have to do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Excellent. For a second there, I was worried we had another Ashley situation on our hands.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ashley was the one who ruined Wilson's football field?
Across the cafeteria, Ben sees Ashley wandering around alone.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Haven't you ever wondered why someone as hot as Ashley is dating a nerd?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She was forgotten.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then come with me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh brother. Here he goes...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for the warning, Hector, but I'd like to try it on my own.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't say I didn't warn you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, come on, sit down.
Ben sits, and the other popular kids immediately look over at him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hi, you're Ben, right? Where's your buddy Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, he's around.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, you and your friend are welcome to stay anytime.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, totally. You really helped Centerscore out back during the Homecoming Game. That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks! Anything for Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you're kind of cute... Are you dating anyone?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's Denni, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's cute, he's blushing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As if it isn't obvious. Girls know things.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So tell us something about yourself...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm into science...
The lunch period passes by smoothly until the bell rings!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See you tomorrow, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks!
As they walk out of the cafeteria, Ben turns to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That didn't seem so bad.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Watch and learn...
Later that week...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I'm back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, cool. You can sit down, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to hear about my latest science experiment?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Isn't that like a school subject?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Can we talk about something else?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, sure..
The following week...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I'm back...
Ben sits down.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, watch where you're sitting freshman. I don't know if you understand how things work around here, but you can't just sit at the popular table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't you remember me? I'm Ben...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All I heard was 'blah blah blah'.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor, who is this guy? Brent?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aww, not that again. I'm `Ben.` I helped you guys win the Homecoming Game. I'm the guy who figured out how Wilson was cheating?
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, not that again. I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben.[/i][/color] I helped you guys win the Homecoming Game. I'm the guy who figured out how Wilson was cheating?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? No... That guy was way cuter.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector was right! Popular people are quick to forget!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector! You were there. Tell these girls that I'm the cute guy they're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, bro, I warned you what would happen if you took this shortcut... I can't save you now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, what are you still doing here? I thought I made it clear. I don't want to see your face around here again!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, sure I'll get out of your way.
Ben walks away dejectedly, his heart sinking.
Looks like Hector was right! Just sitting at the Center Table isn't enough to make Ben popular! He's got to earn his way up!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Congratulations! You've taken care of Dreadlord Mordragon. The local townspeople hold a festival in your honor and revere all of you for your strength and valor. What do you do now?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I would like to approach a girl!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The flirtatious maid Allyria flirts coyly with you.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I want to flirt back! I compliment her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You have successfully complimented Allyria. She kisses you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, time out. Is this really what you nerds do all the time? Because it's kind of lame.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, I think I could write a more compelling story than this.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No way! There's nothing better than an adventure! You get to kiss a girl, infiltrate a dark castle, and gain fame in the local town!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I got to do all those things in real life! I kissed a real girl, snuck into Wilson, and everyone liked me when I helped Centerscore!
Ben looks over at the Center Table where the football players are patting each other on the back. Around them, the girls share jokes and laugh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to actually contribute to something, to do something real.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Not everyone gets to live the dream.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But everyone should try!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, Erik. I like hanging out with you guys, but I don't want to just be a nerd after being a Homecoming Prince.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no turning back now... I want to be popular. I want to join the Center Table!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Gasp! A nerd going straight to the top? It could throw the entire social schema into chaos!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I `am` feeling a bit discombobulated!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] feeling a bit discombobulated!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What an interesting character development...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So what's your plan?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're just going to walk over there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually... I'm just going to walk over there.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you think you can bridge the gap? It's... It's all the way across the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Says the legend who walked from the other side of town...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In many ways, this journey will be longer and harder...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But somebody has to try.
Ben takes his tray and walks smoothly over to the popular table. Howard smiles as he approaches.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey man, how's it going?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Pretty well.
Ben starts to sit down, but Hector steps in his way!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you value your popularity, you won't sit down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know that move.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A new guy gets it into his head he wants to be popular. He walks and sits down at the Center Table where all the popular people sit.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: After all, they're all popular. If they accept him, he will be popular.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But no! Many a freshmen have looked to make it big here at the Center Table, and many have failed...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because sitting is easy... Staying is hard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you going off about, Hector? Just let him sit down.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax, I'm trying to help the kid out. If he wants to be popular, he's got to know the ropes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But he's a hero. He saved the Homecoming Game last week.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, last week. But what about this week or next week? You know what they say... Popular people have good looks, but terrible memories!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is `not` a saying...
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a saying...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes, it is! You just forgot it... Proving my point!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, the reality is, even if they welcome Ben now, he has a shelf life of a week. Tops.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There was another freshman who wanted to be just like you, who pulled an awesome prank on Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What was the prank?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She used her chemistry skills to burn a 'Centerscore' onto Wilson's football field! It was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I can't believe I didn't think of that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And she was welcomed to the popular table for a full two weeks! But after that, she just disappeared...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't scare him, Hector. Geez, just let him take a seat already.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fine, don't take my advice. But I remember what it was like to be you... I used to feel nerdy, alone, unloved...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, harsh!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I'm telling you, if you want to make it big, you have to `earn` your way to the top table.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm telling you, if you want to make it big, you have to [color=#e23b3b][i]earn[/i][/color] your way to the top table.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And just how are you going to do that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, I'm going to hit him with my harp?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ben Bravely the Bard runs at Dreadlord Mordragon. He swings his harp and jumps up!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Success! The harp crashes down on Dreadlord Mordragon with a loud twang! The dastardly villain tries to free himself, but trips!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Who knew that Dreadlord Mordragon's greatest weakness was the harp?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're going to what?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'll admit, I didn't see that one coming.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We're not here to entertain him, we're here to slay him!
Angie rolls a die.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Success! Ben's harp has captured Dreadlord Mordragon' attention...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And due to a traumatic childhood involving the playing of harps for hours on end that eventually turned him evil, Dreadlord Mordragon falls to his knees, his hands clamping over his ears!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He begs Ben to stop and surrenders!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Who knew that Dreadlord Mordragon's weak spot was music?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My birthday was a few weeks ago... And we still haven't celebrated.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm sorry, son. It's been busy at work. But I didn't forget. We'll definitely do it this `Thursday`, I promise.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, son. It's been busy at work. But I didn't forget. We'll definitely do it this [color=#e23b3b][i]Thursday[/i][/color], I promise.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'll come home from work around seven, and we'll hang out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great! You know, I've been thinking of fun flavors for our `cake bake...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Great! You know, I've been thinking of fun flavors for our [color=#e23b3b][i]cake bake...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Good. Great. Looking forward to testing it.
Mr. Kale turns back to the chemicals on the counter.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about asparagus cake with peanut butter frosting? Doesn't that sound awesome?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Sounds delicious.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, okay. Great. I'm going to head to school then. Bye!
Mr. Kale doesn't look up.
At lunchtime that day, Spencer and Ben go to the edges of the lunch room where the nerds are.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're sure you want to sit with us, Spencer? I didn't think the nerd table was your kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, it beats sitting at the football table and getting glared at.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't get it. I joined their stupid team, won the Homecoming Game, Phil's back now... And I still don't get invited to sit at the popular table without someone raising a stink about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They just have to get used to you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I wish they'd hurry up about it. So for today, I'm sitting with you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Suit yourself.
The nerds sit in a large circle, crowding around a pile of dice and what looks to be a large grid.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey guys, running another campaign?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No, finishing our old one. You want to join? We need another bard and an extra warrior.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Role-playing isn't really my forte...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you guys even doing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Role-playing! It's where you take on the role of a character and go on adventures.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds nerdy.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, but it's fun! I'm an assassin, and I can sneak around and take down enemies from behind.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So you're saying I can punch someone with words? I'm in. I'll be the warrior. Ben, you in?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. I guess that makes me the bard.
Ben and Spencer sit down and grab character sheets.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Last we left off, the intrepid thief Dextrous Shadowguard and his party infiltrated the dark castle of Dreadlord Mordragon the Wicked...

nodes.speaker: Angie

nodes.text: Can't I do both? With a little scheduling, I'm sure I could squeeze it all in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great. We'll be sure to keep you in the loop. So... Are you dating anyone?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually there is a girl I'm interested in...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh. Well, good luck with her.
Jessica turns back to Maria, and they start giggling.
Hector slides in next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Two party invitations, and a nod from Jessica? How does it feel to become a star?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's feels good to be on top.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you're not quite there yet. Sure, no one's going to kick you out, but you still have a few levels to go.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you want to be legendary... You have to do one last thing...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Throw the best party ever! How about it? Halloween's coming up. Your house could be the place we party at.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why not? If you're worried about how to do it, I'd help you out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not that. It's just... I can't invite that many people over. My dad would never allow it because there's too much lab equipment at the house...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You'll have to party at someone else's place.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, all right. Just saying this could really help you out. No one forgets you if you throw a huge party.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice.
Hector turns away from Ben to talk to someone else.
That night, Ben comes home, flushed with pride at being welcomed to the popular table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad! I'm home, and ready for cake baking!
No one answers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Dad?
Ben wanders into the kitchen, where a note has been left on the dining room table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'Dear Ben, some urgent business came up, so I'm going out of town. I'll be back in two weeks. From Dad.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's... He's gone?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He didn't even say anything about my birthday or our plans tonight...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He didn't even bother to wait and tell me in person he was going to be gone!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's like he doesn't even care!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So why should I?
Ben takes out his phone and dials Hector.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector... About that party...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's throw it at `my house.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's throw it at [color=#e23b3b][i]my house.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Looks like Ben has a lot to look forward to!
Good job helping Ben get to the Center Table! But can you help him stay there?
Find out next time on Surviving High School!

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, about that... What's the next step? I've dealt with the rebels, so what now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: After the rebels, my friend, are the obscure athletes. Lacrosse players, golfers...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like the swim team! I already know Sam! That's at least one, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Being popular is more than knowing just one of them. It means befriending all of them!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That'll take a lot of time...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No one said being popular was `easy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No one said being popular was [color=#e23b3b][i]easy.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The lunch bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anyway, that's my cue to go. Remember what I said!
On Wednesday after school, Ben, Spencer, and the nerds talk strategy in the library.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's the plan, clan leader?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Our plan is to fit in with the swim team. We meet here to figure out our way in.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How are we going to do that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's easy. The swim team's a bunch of girls. All you need to do is talk to them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That shouldn't be too hard.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We talk to Angie here all the time.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, about `Ogres and Elves.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, about [color=#3b78e2][i]Ogres and Elves.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't talk to the swim girls about role-playing games.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You need to talk to them about things they care about. Like `swimming.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You need to talk to them about things they care about. Like [color=#e23b3b][i]swimming.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right, that means we study up. There's a section in the library devoted to the sport...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do we have to read about swimming only? I mean, physics can easily be applied to movement in the water...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I could apply some chemical knowledge to the composition of chlorine water...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And there's an episode in Space 'Splosions where the Undertaking has to be underwater!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are there any picture books?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'd try sticking straight to swimming. We have to talk about what interests `them`, not `us!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd try sticking straight to swimming. We have to talk about what interests [color=#e23b3b][i]them[/i][/color], not [color=#e23b3b][i]us![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So let's get cracking!
The nerds research in the library... Ben opens a book and reads it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'Swimming is a competitive sport that is enjoyable for males and females of all ages, shape, colors, sizes, geographic locations...'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'The four main strokes are the freestyle, the backstroke, the breast stroke, and the butterfly stroke, and each has advantages and disadvantages in terms of speed, distance, execution...'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, this book is boring... And I'm not a sports guy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I can't slack off now! If I'm going to the Center Table, I need to memorize this stuff!
It's lunch on Thursday, and Ben, Spencer, and all the nerds except Dex approach the swim table...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Remember what we're here for, men.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Men `and` Angie. We need to infiltrate the swim table, and that means pulling out your swim facts!
nodes.text_bbcode: Men [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Angie. We need to infiltrate the swim table, and that means pulling out your swim facts!

nodes.text: The nerds stop in front of the swim table, and the girls stop their conversation to look up at them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Spencer, what's up?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, what do you guys want?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We wanted to ask you a few things about swimming...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: At what speed does the high drag resistance from the water prevent forward movement?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And what are the degenerative effects of chlorine on the human body over prolonged measures of time?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Er, what?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do the native fish populations of the planet ever interfere with how well you move through water?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Is this a joke?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think what they mean is... We have questions about things like efficiency... How do you enter the water from the block?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And just how much force does it take you to perform the butterfly stroke?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do you know when it's time to use all your energy in one burst of speed or to pace yourself?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Can't you find these answers in a book somewhere?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're the experts. I'd like to hear it from you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, why don't you guys take a seat, and we'll talk?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure!
And for the rest of the period, the nerds enjoy their lunch, learning from the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's about body position. The way you move through the water determines how efficient you are...
Sharing with them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, Jane, I heard that the first woman to swim the English Channel beat out the fastest man's record at the time.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Cool!
Even bonding with them!
Ben scrambles to think of a good question, but nothing comes forth!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't remember a single thing I read!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, uh, how do girls do that thing where they move forward in the water?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And is it true that there are, uh, swimming strokes that make you fly in the air?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Are you mocking our sport? You know it's just like a guy to do that. Just because swimming doesn't get as much funding or publicity as football doesn't mean it's not important.
Erik steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He didn't mean to disrespect female traditions!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We wanted to ask you real swimming questions because you ladies are experts, and we want to hear you talk.
Erik winks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a sad day when I'm being saved by Erik.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Geez, Jane, you're always misinterpreting things.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Someone has to stand up for women's rights.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean they have to stand up to listen to you rant. Why don't you guys take a seat, and we'll talk.
The nerds sit down and enjoy lunch with the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But no girl is as good a swimmer as Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Erik. I have a lot to learn.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But hearing your swimming times, it seems like you could go big!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe. That's the hope.
Until at last, the lunch bell rings.
Ben, Spencer, and the nerds walk away from the table.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think that went well.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, today the swim team, tomorrow the Center Table!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I feel more popular already.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm afraid I won't be able to continue on this journey any longer, Benjamin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Why?
Erik looks back at Sara, packing up her lunch.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm happy at the swim table. I don't want to leave it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And you know what they say... H2O's before bros...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I can't argue with that. Good luck, Erik...
After lunch, Ben runs into Hector on the way to class!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's my next step?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Make a name for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like Ben Bravely the Bard?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't talk about Cougars and Shelves in front of me. I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You need to make a name, carve out a reputation for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought I already did that. I'm Ben Kale the Scientist Slash Hacker.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, we really have to work on your names. Rule number one, if you're going to have a title, it should at least rhyme.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Rule number two, it should never have 'science' in it! No, you have to do something great. Popular kids are usually popular because they're charming...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And they also have something to them. They're funny, or they're just so cool you have to be their friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if I can be cool...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then go for funny. The next time a teacher asks you a question, be a clown instead of a know-it-all. Make a joke, dude.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean... Answer a question wrong?! But I've never answered a question wrong in my life!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've never been popular either.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess you're right...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good luck, soldier.
That night, Ben sets the table and waits for his dad to come home...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He said he'd be here around seven, and it's already fifteen minutes past that. Hopefully, it's traffic.
Fifteen minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wonder if he even remembered...
Another thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope he's okay...
Mr. Kale comes through the front door.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad, you're home! Did you get the stuff?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Get what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Ben, I can't play one of your guessing games right now. What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The stuff for baking a cake? My birthday tradition? Whipping up a weird tasting cake?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Oh. Something important came up at work. An emergency.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A smell emergency?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Don't be silly. Just a minor chemical mishap. I got it all straightened out.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: And about your birthday... Can we do it tomorrow? Is that okay?
Hector takes Ben on a tour of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The only way to become popular, Ben, is to start from ground up. You're a science guy, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Think of yourself like a comet. You're traveling the outer reaches of space right now, but you want to make your way to the sun.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And to do that you have to get past the attractional orbits of the planets. Once you do, bam! You're a star! You follow?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not how stars are made...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you get what I'm saying. You have to work your way up to Center Table! Only by proving how cool you are to each clique can you become truly popular.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right now, you're at the nerds. You need to get to the next level.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is the next level?
Hector turns Ben so he's facing the rebel table.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Boom. Next level, next planet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How is getting in with the rebels going to make me popular? Don't the rebels hate you guys?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You raise a good point. It's true the rebels and the Center Table have never gotten along.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you need to make your name among the rebels because it increases your rep.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The rebels might not like us popular kids, but they definitely respect us enough as enemies to leave us alone.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You need them to respect you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And just how am I going to do that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Social proof. That's all you need. Impress them! Show them you should be revered!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When you get past them, talk to me.
Hector strolls back to the Center Table, and Ben sits with the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what'd party guy say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector told me I have to work my way up to the Center Table. But now I think I should've just sat down.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, Hector's right. It's not that easy to move up to the Center Table. You can't just go up there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you sit there all the time.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Because $Scott is my boyfriend. If he weren't, I wouldn't be able to set foot within a, well, a foot of that table!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Besides, I like sitting with you guys. I've never really felt like I fit in there. What you're talking about, Ben, is `belonging` to that table.
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, I like sitting with you guys. I've never really felt like I fit in there. What you're talking about, Ben, is [color=#3b78e2][i]belonging[/i][/color] to that table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Exactly. And I think I do.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That is a world I'll never be a part of.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, don't talk like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When I was the Guy That Pranked Wilson, everyone knew my name. I liked it. I liked people knowing who I was. I wasn't invisible or ignored.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like the townspeople when we defeated Dreadlord Mordragon, we could be recognized! `All` of us! We can do it together!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like the townspeople when we defeated Dreadlord Mordragon, we could be recognized! [color=#e23b3b][i]All[/i][/color] of us! We can do it together!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Count all of us in, Ben! You have everything you need! You've got my intellect!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And my organization!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And my axe!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Come on, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Today, we're going to take destiny into our own hands! We're going to take an adventure...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A journey to the Center Table!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now that is a story worth recording...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds pretty cool, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And our first stop is the rebel table! We need to earn their respect!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I already have their respect. And their fear!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then you can help us, Spencer. Help us with the rebels, and we'll help you fit in with the football team!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right. But what are you going to do to get to the rebels?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to...
Ben takes his tray and walks smoothly over to the popular table. Howard smiles as he approaches.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey man, how's it going?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Pretty well.
Ben starts to sit down, but Hector steps in his way!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you value your popularity, you won't sit down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know that move.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A new guy gets it into his head he wants to be popular. He walks and sits down at the Center Table where all the popular people sit.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: After all, they're all popular. If they accept him, he will be popular.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But no! Many a freshmen have looked to make it big here at the Center Table, and many have failed...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because sitting is easy... Staying is hard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you going off about, Hector? Just let him sit down.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax, I'm trying to help the kid out. If he wants to be popular, he's got to know the ropes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But he's a hero. He saved the Homecoming Game last week.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, last week. But what about this week or next week? You know what they say... Popular people have good looks, but terrible memories!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is `not` a saying...
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a saying...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes, it is! You just forgot it... Proving my point!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, the reality is, even if they welcome Ben now, he has a shelf life of a week. Tops.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There was another freshman who wanted to be just like you, who pulled an awesome prank on Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What was the prank?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She used her chemistry skills to burn a 'Centerscore' onto Wilson's football field! It was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I can't believe I didn't think of that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And she was welcomed to the popular table for a full two weeks! But after that, she just disappeared...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't scare him, Hector. Geez, just let him take a seat already.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fine, don't take my advice. But I remember what it was like to be you... I used to feel nerdy, alone, unloved...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, harsh!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I'm telling you, if you want to make it big, you have to `earn` your way to the top table.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm telling you, if you want to make it big, you have to [color=#e23b3b][i]earn[/i][/color] your way to the top table.

nodes.text: At lunch that day, Ben goes up to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector, I did everything you asked. Do you think it's enough?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I have been hearing your name a lot...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I don't think it's all good things.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So I should still try to sit at the Center Table now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It might not be the best time, but...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've done everything you can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then that's good enough for me.
Ben approaches the popular table, but there is a bad feeling rising in his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brent! Just the guy I want to see!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who else would I be talking to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, my name is `actually`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, my name is [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just sit down.
Ben takes the seat next to her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's invited me to sit down! What do I say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me sit here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, just shut up and listen.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't like to associate with the nerds from the outer rings of the cafeteria, but you're a special case.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. I've heard nothing but bad things about you, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: First off, everyone says you were causing a disruption at the Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, normally, I wouldn't mind having you annoy the gel out of those rebels...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you tried to take down Spencer, one of our football players. Football players are the reason we cheerleaders are around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So that's an affront to cheering everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But that was a `fake` fight!
nodes.text_bbcode: But that was a [color=#e23b3b][i]fake[/i][/color] fight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And second thing, you hurt my ears whenever I hear you talk about sports.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You actually notice when I talk?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I try not to tune into the frequency of the masses, but every time I hear you, I regret it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do you care about how I talk about sports?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, they're my ears, right? Of course I care.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which brings me to the last thing... You're not actually that funny.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was kind of an off day...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't really care.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what was the point of you telling me all this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm banning you from the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You, like everyone else who comes here, probably had high hopes of making it big...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm doing you a favor by squashing those hopes now.
Uh-oh! Taylor went out of her way to tell Ben she didn't want to see him near the popular table again? That's majorly sad!
Try again and see if you can get Ben at that Center Table!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: At lunch, Hector comes up to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You dogg, you really did it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't get all 'excuse me' with me... I've been hearing your name all day. People are `gossiping` about you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't get all 'excuse me' with me... I've been hearing your name all day. People are [color=#e23b3b][i]gossiping[/i][/color] about you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, boy, you have a lot to learn about being at the top.

And for those of you who were wondering whatever happened to Andrew's story-writing...
The nerds assemble at Andrew's house for a reading of his new work, 'The Ballad of Ben'.
Wow, Andrew, I didn't know you had a stage built in your parents' garage...
A performing artist needs to practice, don't you think? And what better way than with a fake stage?
You guys will be my first audience.
Are there going to be snacks?
Concessions are in the fake lobby, and they're overpriced!
Oh...
Silence! I am going to begin.
Andrew takes the stage.
Ahem ahem. `The Ballad of Ben.`
{ Heed my words, this is the tale... {
{ Of the tireless fortitude of Benjamin Kale... {
{ Brave Ben had a dream, the precursor of fable... {
{ To carve out a niche in the Center Table... {
{ He built up his rep from clique to clique... {
{ Using all his means from might to wit... {
{ He rounded up nerds, from far and from near... {
{ Encouraging them with optimistic veneer... {
{ There was Angie the Organized who came color-coded... {
{ And Dex the Dexter-ous who was quickly demoted... {
{ Brendan the Spacey seemed stuck in a cloud... {
{ While Erik the Erik was lost at Sara's feet whence he bowed... {
{ There was Spencer the Tall... {
{ I guess he played football... {
{ And last but not least, there was Andrew the Charming... {
{ Who spoke with words so sweet the ladies found him disarming... {
{ But back to the point, there was Ben the Great... {
{ In whose hands the heroes trusted their fate... {
{ His first victory was to impress all the rebels... {
{ By felling the giant that made the nerds tremble... {
{ Taking Spencer to his knees caused the rebels amaze... {
{ That they invited Ben to their table in upcoming days... {
{ From thence, Ben the Brave drew closer to his prize... {
{ And by wooing the sirens who swim did he rise... {
{ In studying the art of the water sport they knew... {
{ His status in their eyes suddenly flew... {
{ But Ben's last trial, alas, caused him great pain... {
{ For thwarting a class Ben had tried to avoid in vain... {
{ But with low-brow wit and a rather noble air... {
{ Did Ben manage to attract the popular stare... {
{ And thusly, did Ben at last draw himself nigh... {
{ Onto the throne of the Center Table at Centerscore High! {
Andrew takes a bow and leaves the stage.
In the audience, the nerds clap, some enthusiastically, some half-heartedly.
Did you hear, guys? I was in it! I was in a ballad.
Your title is Erik `the Erik.`
It's a fine title.
Yeah, well, I was Spencer the Tall!
Writers have to take creative liberties. If you're unhappy with your lot, you need to do something that shines.
Like Ben!
I rather liked it.
It was about you!
Just be glad I didn't write about Spencer the Oaf.
I'll oaf your face!

Ahhhhhhh!
...Well, let's hope Andrew can write his way out of `this` situation!

nodes.text: It's Monday morning before school.
At the Kale household, Ben talks while helping his dad work at the dining table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...And because of the prank that Spencer and I pulled, I became Homecoming Prince! I've never been nominated for anything in my life!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: That's nice, son. Now can you put in two drops of Solvent 2? If I'm right, this should be the last step.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, of course...
As they wait for Mr. Kale's concoction to mix, Ben starts up again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then I helped the football team win the Homecoming Game! It was a pretty awesome plan.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't call it 'brilliant', but I consider it to be a pretty `big...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I wouldn't call it 'brilliant', but I consider it to be a pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]big...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: No, I was talking about the solution I've just found.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Professor Dean will feel so foolish now that I've perfected the 'banana apple' smell... I call it 'banapple'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's great, Dad. Congratulations...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But did you hear what I said? I helped the `football team.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But did you hear what I said? I helped the [color=#e23b3b][i]football team.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mr. Kale looks at Ben, as if seeing him for the first time.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Ben, I'm glad you're fitting in at school, but... Joining the football team is just going to get in the way of your academics.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't join the team, I just `helped` them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't join the team, I just [color=#e23b3b][i]helped[/i][/color] them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Right, but I want to remind you that the better the work you do in school, the better your work will be when you graduate from college and get a job.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Shouldn't you be focusing more on your education?

options.label: Yeah, I guess work is pretty important...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, nerd leader! You, with the brown hair!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Are you talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who else would I be talking to? Come here. Sit a minute. Your friends can come too.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And Ben Bravely the Bard was told to come forth...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm being invited to the rebel table!
They sit down.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We've never sat at this table before.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, don't get used to it. This is a one-time invite.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I saw what you nerds did with that Spencer guy. Ryan here tells us he's a hard nut.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: He used to threaten me for money.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Us too.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, you skinny nerds were really tough. The best part was watching you other three hang onto him and wrestle him to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I have to admit, it was kind of impressive.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So you can eat with us today.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!
Dex sidles up to Megan.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Megan, you have lovely eyes.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Uh-huh. And you won't, once I poke them out.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Eep!
Dex stands up, taking his lunch with him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Back to the nerd table where the games are safe and where I can get a girl without risking vision loss!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm really surprised to see you here.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All part of my plan to make it to the center.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Ben, I heard you got into an epic fight after school!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, the nerds and I showed the Auto-Shop that we were tough.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're really making a name for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, man, your name's buzzing around the entire school!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First the rebels, now the sports teams? You're on the up and up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I heard someone mention your name yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds like you're making some real progress.
At lunch that day, Ben goes up to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector, I did everything you asked. Do you think it's enough?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I have been hearing your name a lot...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I don't think it's all good things.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So I should still try to sit at the Center Table now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It might not be the best time, but...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've done everything you can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then that's good enough for me.
Ben approaches the popular table, but there is a bad feeling rising in his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brent! Just the guy I want to see!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who else would I be talking to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, my name is `actually`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, my name is [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just sit down.
Ben takes the seat next to her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's invited me to sit down! What do I say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me sit here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, just shut up and listen.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't like to associate with the nerds from the outer rings of the cafeteria, but you're a special case.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. I've heard nothing but bad things about you, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: First off, everyone says you were causing a disruption at the Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, normally, I wouldn't mind having you annoy the gel out of those rebels...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you tried to take down Spencer, one of our football players. Football players are the reason we cheerleaders are around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So that's an affront to cheering everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But that was a `fake` fight!
nodes.text_bbcode: But that was a [color=#e23b3b][i]fake[/i][/color] fight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And second thing, you hurt my ears whenever I hear you talk about sports.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You actually notice when I talk?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I try not to tune into the frequency of the masses, but every time I hear you, I regret it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do you care about how I talk about sports?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, they're my ears, right? Of course I care.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which brings me to the last thing... You're not actually that funny.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was kind of an off day...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't really care.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what was the point of you telling me all this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm banning you from the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You, like everyone else who comes here, probably had high hopes of making it big...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm doing you a favor by squashing those hopes now.
Uh-oh! Taylor went out of her way to tell Ben she didn't want to see him near the popular table again? That's majorly sad!
